Title: Service Fabric SDK and Runtime for version 5.2 released

Body.Content:
Azure Service Fabric SDK 2.2.207 and Runtime 5.2.207 are released. This release includes a number of new features, along with a set of important bug fixes. You can get the updated SDK from these links:

  • Runtime, SDK, and tools for Visual Studio 2015 (requires Visual Studio 2015 Update 2 or later)
  • Runtime and SDK only (no Visual Studio tools)

For more information, see the release announcement on the Service Fabric team blog.
